steps.observation: Work on this for 60 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Here are three major underlying causes of World War I:  
1. Militarism  
   – The great powers engaged in an arms race, building large standing armies and navies.  
2. Alliance Systems  
   – Europe was divided into rival blocs (e.g. the Triple Entente vs. the Triple Alliance), which meant a conflict involving one power could quickly draw in its allies.  
3. Nationalism  
   – Intense national pride and ethnic tensions (especially in the Balkans) stoked rivalries and fostered a climate ripe for conflict.
